scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.vitest.json
